headline: RBI said 7%, India delivered 7.8%: Amid war and inflation, India's GDP grew at rocket speed, surpassing RBI's expectations; impact of growth in IT and real estate
summary: India's economy grew 7.8% in the first quarter of 2026 (April-June), stronger than the Reserve Bank of India's 7% estimate, despite inflation pressures from tensions in West Asia.
why: GDP growth is a key gauge of India's economic health, shaping expectations for interest-rate policy by the Reserve Bank of India and returns on Indian assets.
